title: How to Create an Auth Module Provider

types.name: identifier
types.description:
Every auth provider must have an `identifier` static property. The provider's ID
will be stored as `au_{identifier}_{id}`, where `{id}` is the provider's `id` 
property in the `medusa-config.ts`.
types.example: class MyAuthProviderService extends AbstractAuthModuleProvider { static identifier = "my-auth" // ... }

types.name: DISPLAY_NAME
types.description: This property indicates the name used when displaying the provider on a frontend application.
types.example: class MyAuthProviderService extends AbstractAuthModuleProvider { static DISPLAY_NAME = "My Auth" // ... }
